Bachelor Dinner
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 11:58pm

Ingredients




1 bag Pop Secret with butter
1 Popcorn bowl

Preparation

1 Open microwave door. Remove plastic wrapping from popcorn bag. Place in microwave "this side up". Program microwave 4 minutes, high power. Press start button. Listen for popcorn to stop popping or smell of burnt popcorn. 2 Press stop button. (If burnt, repeat step one with new bag.) Serve in designated popcorn bowl.
